claim_text: Independent contemporaneous federal-court reporting states that Fahima Egeh Mahamud pleaded guilty on July 9, 2026 in United States v. Mahamud, No. 0:26-cr-00097-JWB, to wire fraud and conspiracy to defraud the United States. This disposition is secondary-verified pending capture of the plea agreement, change-of-plea minute, or another primary court record.

supporting_passages.quote: pleaded guilty in federal court to wire fraud and conspiracy to defraud the United States
pleaded guilty Thursday in U.S. District Court to wire fraud and conspiring to defraud the U.S.

qualifiers: SECONDARY_VERIFIED until primary plea record is captured
DOJ's public Minnesota court-document index was updated July 29, 2026 but still linked only Mahamud's Information; that publication lag does not negate the plea
do not assign Mahamud a DOJ-issued 68th or 69th conviction ordinal from this claim
sentencing remained pending in the contemporaneous reports
editorial_notes: This closes the question of whether a July 9 plea is well-supported in the open record while preserving the separate unresolved question of DOJ's scheme-wide conviction counting convention.
